notes:
- Frag grenades: press G to throw. They arc, bounce off walls and floors and blow up after 2.5 s
  (they hurt you too). You start with 2; Max Ammo refills them and each new round gives one back (max 2).
  The count is shown next to the weapon slots.
- Headshot kills play a satisfying crunch-and-chime.
- Zombies no longer walk inside each other: they push apart and crowd around you instead.
- Customizing your survivor in the menu no longer resets the character's rotation.
- Cryo Freezer (Mystery Box): a new wonder weapon. An icy beam (18 m, goes through 3 zombies) chills
  zombies: they slow down and frost over, then freeze solid. Kill them and they shatter into ice.
- Weapon slots on the HUD: [1] and [2] for your guns and [3] for your melee weapon, each with a picture
  of the actual weapon (upgraded guns show their purple finish). Press 1 / 2 to switch, 3 to swing.
- See-through Longshot scope: the magnified view sits in the scope lens and you can still see
  everything around it (no more black screen).
- Upgrade machine takes your gun while it works; when it's done, take the upgraded gun out of the
  machine. Empty-handed meanwhile, you can still melee. The machine now has a light beam so it's easy to
  find (it was there, just far away on the bigger maps).
- Your level in-game: the Tab scoreboard has a level column and the pause menu shows your level, rank
  and XP bar, counting this game's XP live. Levelling up mid-game pops a "LEVEL UP!" banner with a sound.
- Perks: after drinking, you throw the empty bottle down and it smashes (glass sound, shards).
- Detailed hands: voxel gloves with fingers wrapped round the grip and handguard, knuckles, cuffs, a
  watch, and sleeves with seams. The trigger finger pulls on every shot, hands squeeze on recoil and the
  fingers drum now and then.
- Outskirts: neighbouring streets, yards and the park are open to each other (no more barricades in
  see-through fences leading to more street); barricades only lead into buildings.
- Smaller red dots on the SMG / Tri-Burst / AR / Zapper / Cryo sights.
- Slightly slower movement (walk 5.0 to 4.4, sprint 8.0 to 7.0).
- Thumper self damage: standing in your own blast hurts.
- Fixed: zombies getting stuck at the bottom of stairs (they cut the corner into the side of the steps).
- Fixed: blood from shots sprayed onto the floor far from the zombie.
